desc:
QUALITY INGREDIENTS: Crispy wafers made without artificial flavors, artificial colors, or high fructose corn syrup; 14g of whole grains per serving (at least 48g recommended daily)

PORTABLE SNACK: Easy, wholesome wafer bars make a tasty part of snack time or an on the go treat; Perfect for the pantry, lunch box, and hiking trail

CRISPY AND CREAMY: Savor the delicious balance of crispy and creamy textures in every bite

TASTY LAYERS: Made with light and crispy wafers, layers of strawberry flavored filling, and a sweet topping with crunchy granola

CONTAINS: One regular cardboard box of Nature Valley Crispy Creamy Wafer Bars, Strawberry, 5 Bars, 6.5 oz Box; Perfect for instant snacking
features:
Key Features:

Crispy Whole-Grain Wafers

Light, crunchy wafer layers made with whole grains for a satisfying bite.

Strawberry-Flavored Cream Filling

A smooth, sweet strawberry filling adds a creamy contrast to the crisp texture.

Granola-Topped Exterior

The outer coating includes granola bits for extra flavor and texture.

No Artificial Flavors or Colors

Free from high-fructose corn syrup, artificial flavors, or synthetic colors.

Individually Wrapped

Conveniently packaged for easy snacking at school, work, or on-the-go.

Whole Grain Goodness

Each bar contains 14 grams of whole grain, helping contribute to daily nutrition goals.

Benefits:

Tasty and Satisfying Texture

The combination of crunchy wafers, creamy filling, and granola makes it enjoyable to eat.

Great for Busy Lifestyles

Perfect grab-and-go snack option for travel, school lunches, or afternoon cravings.

Kid-Friendly Flavor

The mild strawberry flavor and light texture appeal to both kids and adults.

Supports Healthier Snacking

Made with whole grains and no artificial additives—more wholesome than many sweet snacks.

Portion Controlled

Individually wrapped for better portion awareness and freshness.
ingredients: Oat Butter (whole grain oat flour, palm oil, sugar, canola oil, corn starch, salt), Whole Grain Wheat Flour, Sugar, Palm and Palm Kernel Oil, Whole Grain Oats, Maltodextrin, Fructose, Whey, Strawberry Powder, Soy Lecithin, Corn Starch, Salt, Natural Flavor, Baking Soda.
